unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The paper-local supplementary assets are repeated HTML landing pages that expose an external static-content PDF URL, but no local Supplementary Information PDF, extracted supplementary table text, OOXML workbook, archive member, image payload, or OCR-ready supplement file exists under the packet raw/extracted folders, landed paper folder, or searched local corpus roots.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Supplementary Tables/Figures supporting the 100-guavanin design set, top-15 screening/modeling, antibiofilm result, and supporting structural plots cannot be source-reviewed locally. Main-paper Guavanin 2 Table 1 activity, Fig. 5 sequence, and direct mechanism evidence were repaired and retained, but the paper remains non-publication-grade under obtainable-only mode.
